staticFindings.summary: Program body and cleanup/export waits are not covered by an absolute host Page deadline. A response body can remain pending before finally; iframe watchdog does not bound that host wait.

Content-Encoding is recorded but not refused. Declared bytes are reserved before body(), while decoded size is checked only after full materialization; this does not impose a strict decoded-buffer bound.

Factory is called once, but wrapper returns promise.then rather than the original Promise, changing identity and the caller settlement boundary. Loaded value/reason forwarding alone is narrower than claimed result preservation.

Some diagnostic reads/appends run outside protected boundaries; they can prevent an original call or turn successful Core evaluation into a diagnostic throw. Original call exceptions propagate but do not uniformly disable/classify capture when handled upstream. New Page observer setup also precedes its finally lifetime.
